question: A function is represented by a table: \(f(1)=2\), \(f(2)=5\), and \(f(4)=11\). Find \(f(1)+f(4)\).
solution: Read the corresponding values directly from the table: \(f(1)=2\) and \(f(4)=11\). Their sum is \(13\).
